The loss in the year is the combination of several factors including material exposure to hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes particularly on the Property account.

gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1206 experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 11.547 million in 2017. This was primarily driven by adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes, exacerbated by the impact of 2017 natural catastrophes including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquakes, and Californian Wildfires on these prior year estimates. Partially offsetting this strengthening was a release in Liability class reserves, attributed to the release of the 2016 Ogden margin and overall favourable claims development for that class.
